row.scim_plan: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service
row.sso_plan: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service
row.evidence: Adobe Commerce lists every package with 'Get pricing' only; Commerce as a Cloud Service users get Admin access through the Adobe Admin Console, whose Microsoft Entra ID Sync 'uses the SCIM protocol'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service (SaaS), Commerce on Cloud (PaaS) and Commerce Optimizer are all 'Get pricing'. New in September 2026; Magento is sold today as Adobe Commerce. On the SaaS product, users are added in the Adobe Admin Console, which accepts SCIM from Microsoft Entra ID (Entra ID Sync) and Google Workspace (Google Sync autoprovisioning) on a federated directory; deprovisioning disables the user and keeps assets. No generic SCIM endpoint is documented, and the Okta catalogue's Adobe apps are SWA only. On Commerce on Cloud (PaaS) the optional Adobe IMS login (2.4.5+, not in Magento Open Source) still manages Admin users and roles inside Commerce, so there is no SCIM there; Magento Open Source is free with local Admin users only.

scim.plan: Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service

operations.notes: Deprovisioning from Entra disables the user; permanent deletion is a manual Admin Console step after enabling editing.

deprovision.data_retained: Disabled users can no longer sign in; the account and cloud-stored assets are kept until an admin permanently deletes the user in the Admin Console.

custom.how: Google Organizational Unit path mapped to urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Adobe:2.0:User:organizationalUnit

attributes.notes: Attribute names as listed for the Google Sync mapping.

roles.how: Synced user groups are assigned Commerce product profiles in the Admin Console; Commerce roles are set under System > Permissions > User Roles.

limitations.text: Entra ID Sync needs a federated directory with a domain; trustee Admin Consoles cannot use it.
Group-based assignment from Entra needs Entra ID P1/P2 or Microsoft 365 E3/A3.
Users in groups with the HiddenMembership attribute are not synced.

scim.notes: SCIM lands in the Adobe Admin Console (Adobe's org-wide identity layer), which grants access to the Commerce as a Cloud Service Admin through product profiles. Adobe documents it only through the Microsoft Entra ID Sync and Google Sync (Google autoprovisioning) apps; no generic SCIM endpoint or token is documented. Commerce on Cloud (PaaS) and Magento Open Source manage Admin users inside Commerce, with no SCIM.

user_api.notes: Adobe's org-level User Management API (Admin Console) is named as a way to create, manage and license Federated ID users; its reference was not loaded, so endpoints are not listed. No admin-user endpoints were checked in the Commerce REST API.

okta.notes: OIN 'Adobe Enterprise' (last updated Aug. 5 2025) and 'Adobe' mark only SWA (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Adobe's guide configures provisioning in the existing Adobe Identity Management app in Entra; the Entra gallery page itself was not loaded.

google.notes: Google Sync uses autoprovisioning on the Adobe SAML app in Google Workspace (SCIM extension schema in the attribute mapping).
